e.body:
**Anthem Extensions**（VS Code 扩展 `AnthemInc.vscode-anthem-extensions`）**是一家**美国健康险公司**发在**公共插件市场**上的**内部测试工具****——**逐字自述为**「**Supports running unit tests by right clicking folder or spec file, cucumber feature bdd tests, pull cucumber features from xray-jira and upload cucumber results.**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**编辑器插件市场：保险关键词下到底有什么**」**。

**可核实信息（均 VS Code 市场接口与其自带说明实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 保险公司把内部研发工具放在了公共市场上****——**⭐ 本次实测**其发布者逐字为 **`AnthemInc`**、**名称逐字为 **`Anthem Extensions`****；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一形态**值得记**：**⭐ 即**一家**保险公司的**内部测试工具**被**公开发布**，**且**在**六年多里**被**安装 **2,709 次**——**⭐ 说明**它**可能**被**公司外部的人**也**用上了**（**⭐ 本词条**不推测**使用者构成**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 发布者与仓库所有者不是同一个主体****——**⭐ 本次实测**其**源码仓库字段逐字为 **`https://github.com/mlakmal/vscode-anthem-extensions.git`****，**许可链接**亦**指向**该仓库的 **README****；**⭐ 而**发布者名**逐字为 **`AnthemInc`****。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**最有价值**：**⭐ 即**「**谁发布**」与**「**谁维护**」**分离**是**公共市场上**一种**常见而**容易被忽略的**状态**——**⭐ 对**使用者**而言**，**这**决定了**遇到问题时**能找谁**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**读**插件或**开源项目**时**应当**分别记录**发布主体与**代码归属**。**⭐⭐ ③ 功能面**逐条写清，**围绕**「**测试 → 需求追溯**」**这条链路****——**⭐ 本次实测**其说明逐字列出**：**右键**单文件与**按目录**运行**单测**（**逐字含**「**for unit testing single spec file, you can right click on *spec.ts file**」**）**、**BDD（**Cucumber）特性**、**从 **Xray-Jira** 拉取**特性**，**以及**回传 **Cucumber** 结果****。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**值得记**：**⭐ 即**它**把**「**测试结果**」**与**「**需求管理系统**」**接起来**——**⭐ 而**在**受监管行业里**，「**这条测试覆盖哪一条需求**」**本身**就是**审计问题**。**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 长期未更新，**且**版本号很低****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**版本 **`0.0.11`**、**最后更新 **2018-11-27****；**⭐ 本词条**如实标注**：**⭐ 一个**六年多前**发布的**内部工具**，**其**依赖与**编辑器版本**很可能**已经**不兼容**（**⭐ 本词条**未验证**兼容性**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[titanium-insurance-core]]、**[[cloudco-insurance]] 与**[[insurancepro-crm]] 覆盖**保险核心系统与**客户系统**、**[[quickfire-ams]]、**[[hedvig-ugglan]] 与**[[lemonade-policy-2]] 覆盖**保险公司开源的**业务系统**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**保险公司把**内部研发工具**发到**公共插件市场**，**且**发布主体与**仓库归属**分离**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的四件事**：**① **公司内部工具**也可以**公开发布**（**⭐ 但**要**说清**支持方式**）**；**② **发布主体**与**代码归属**要**分开记录**；**③ **测试工具**要**接上**需求管理**，**便于**审计追溯**；**④ **长期未更新的工具**要**先验证**与**当前版本的**兼容性**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有安装、**没有运行**该扩展**（**未运行任何测试、**未连接任何 **Jira 或 **Xray 实例**）**，**故**不主张**其功能可用**、**不主张**其与**当前 **VS Code 版本**兼容**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**市场接口返回的**元数据**与**其自带的**说明**（**未读**其源码**）**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**该扩展**与**发布公司**的**官方关系**（**⭐ 本词条**只记录**发布者字段**与其**自述**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**仓库所有者 **`mlakmal`** 与**该公司**的关系**（**⭐ 本词条**不推测**其身份**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**安装量 **2,709 次**的**构成**（**⭐ 本词条**不主张**其中**有多少**来自**公司内部**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核实**其**是否**仍能用**（**⭐ 版本停在 **2018 年**，**而**编辑器已**多次大版本更新**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该扩展**是**内部研发工具**，**与**保险产品、**费率或**承保决定**无关**。

**Anthem Extensions**（VS Code 擴充 `AnthemInc.vscode-anthem-extensions`）**是一家**美國健康險公司**發在**公共外掛市場**上的**內部測試工具****——**逐字自述為**「**Supports running unit tests by right clicking folder or spec file, cucumber feature bdd tests, pull cucumber features from xray-jira and upload cucumber results.**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**編輯器外掛市場：保險關鍵詞下到底有什麼**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 VS Code 市場介面與其自帶說明實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 保險公司把內部研發工具放在公共市場上****——**發布者逐字為 `AnthemInc`**、**名稱逐字為 Anthem Extensions****；**⭐ 即**一家保險公司的內部測試工具被公開發布**，**且**在六年多裡被安裝 2,709 次**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 發布者與倉庫所有者不是同一個主體****——**源碼倉庫欄位逐字為 `https://github.com/mlakmal/vscode-anthem-extensions.git`****，**許可連結亦指向該倉庫的 README**；**而**發布者名逐字為 `AnthemInc`****。**⭐ 即**「**誰發布**」與「**誰維護**」分離**是公共市場上一種常見而容易被忽略的狀態**——**⭐ 對使用者而言**，**這決定了遇到問題時能找誰**；**⭐ 對 RIAA**：**讀外掛或開源專案時應分別記錄發布主體與代碼歸屬**。**⭐⭐ ③ 功能面逐條寫清，**圍繞「**測試 → 需求追溯**」這條鏈路****——**右鍵單檔與按目錄運行單測**、**BDD（**Cucumber）特性**、**從 Xray-Jira 拉取特性**，**以及回傳結果****——**⭐ 即**它把測試結果與需求管理系統接起來**，**而在受監管行業裡**，「**這條測試覆蓋哪一條需求**」本身就是審計問題**。**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 長期未更新，**且版本號很低****——**版本 `0.0.11`**、**最後更新 2018-11-27****；**⭐ 即**一個六年多前發布的內部工具**，**其依賴與編輯器版本很可能已不兼容**（**未驗證**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 與池內條目的關係**：[[titanium-insurance-core]]、[[cloudco-insurance]]、[[insurancepro-crm]]、[[quickfire-ams]]、[[hedvig-ugglan]]、[[lemonade-policy-2]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**保險公司把內部研發工具發到公共外掛市場，**且發布主體與倉庫歸屬分離**」這一形態**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 四件事值得借**：**① **內部工具也可以公開發布**；**② **發布主體與代碼歸屬分開記錄**；**③ **測試工具要接上需求管理**；**④ **長期未更新的工具要先驗證兼容性**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有安裝、**沒有運行**該擴充**，**不主張**其功能可用**，**也不主張**其與當前 VS Code 版本兼容**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀市場介面返回的元資料與其自帶說明**（**未讀**其源碼**）**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實**該擴充與發布公司的官方關係**（**只記錄發布者欄位與其自述**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**倉庫所有者 `mlakmal` 與該公司的關係**（**不推測其身份**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**其安裝量 2,709 次的構成**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實**其是否仍能用**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該擴充是內部研發工具**，**與保險產品、**費率或**承保決定無關**。

e.body_en:
This Visual Studio Code extension **is internal test tooling that a United States health insurer published to the public marketplace**, described verbatim as supporting unit tests by right-clicking a folder or specification file, behaviour-driven feature tests, pulling feature files from a test management integration and uploading results back. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the editor plugin marketplace, and of what is actually there under insurance keywords.**

**Verified information, all measured from the marketplace interface and the text the extension ships**: **first, an insurer published internal development tooling on a public marketplace.** The publisher name reads as the company and the extension is named after it, and across more than six years it has been installed two thousand seven hundred and nine times, **which suggests it reached users outside the company as well, although this entry does not speculate about who those users are**. **Second, the publisher and the repository owner are two different entities.** The source repository field points at an individual account, as does the licence link, while the publisher is the company. **That is the most valuable record here: who publishes and who maintains can come apart, a state that is common in public marketplaces and easy to overlook, and it determines whom a user can turn to when something breaks, so a plugin or an open-source project should have its publishing entity and its code ownership recorded separately.** **Third, the feature list is written out and organised around one chain from tests to requirement traceability**: running a single specification file from the editor, running all tests under a folder, behaviour-driven feature tests, pulling features from the test management integration, and uploading results back. **In a regulated industry the question of which requirement a given test covers is itself an audit question.** **Fourth, nothing has been updated for years and the version is very low**, standing at 0.0.11 with a last update in November 2018. **An internal tool released that long ago is likely incompatible with current editor versions, although compatibility was not verified here.** **Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover insurance core and customer systems and several insurers publishing business systems as open source, **while this entry supplies an insurer publishing internal development tooling to a public marketplace with publishing entity and repository ownership separated. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **four practices transfer: internal tools can be published publicly provided support expectations are stated; record the publishing entity and the code ownership separately; connect test tooling to requirement management for audit traceability; and verify compatibility before relying on tooling that has not been updated for years.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the extension was neither installed nor run**, so no tests were executed and no test management instance was contacted, **and no claim is made that it works or that it is compatible with current editor versions**. **Second, only the marketplace metadata and the description it ships were read, not its source code.** **Third, the relationship between the extension and the publishing company was not verified**, only the publisher field and its own account being recorded. **Fourth, the relationship between the repository owner and that company was not verified, and this entry does not speculate about their identity. Fifth, the composition of the install count was not verified**, and no claim is made about how much of it came from inside the company. **Sixth, whether it still works was not verified**, the version standing at 2018 while the editor has since had several major releases. **Seventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the extension is internal development tooling unrelated to insurance products, rates or underwriting decisions.**
